'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Thomas McGee DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Thomas McGee]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Tom McGee
* '''Username:''' Beatstick
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
